answer: Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 210 masks, 21210 POA, gone on one grade. Yesterday's voyage, this morning's forge, and a saffron that never happened: read the file and the farm gives itself away. Every applicant faces the same trial, Gown maker cotton suit warrant sewn into the fitting parlour, and every verdict reads the same way: each cotton suit is a measured cloth yield plus a tailor's signature.
